anomalies.description: A head-on collision occurs between two vehicles in the oncoming lane, resulting in severe vehicle deformation, debris scattering, and dust cloud; one vehicle is pushed sideways and appears to rotate after impact.

A severe head-on or side-impact collision between at least two vehicles on a rural road, resulting in significant vehicle deformation, debris scattered across the road, and a large dust cloud. A small aircraft is visible in the sky above the crash site.
A yellow taxi is struck from behind or sideswiped while driving in city traffic, causing visible rear-end damage (crushed trunk and bumper) and a sudden lateral movement of the vehicle.
A yellow taxi loses control, swerves right, and collides with the concrete median barrier, resulting in severe rear-end damage and the vehicle coming to rest against the barrier.

The vehicle from which the footage is recorded collides with an object (likely a utility pole or roadside vegetation) on the right side of the road, causing violent camera shake, debris impact on the windshield, and loss of view as the vehicle veers off the road.

A multi-vehicle collision occurs on a two-lane road: a black sedan swerves left, collides with an oncoming white sedan, and a third vehicle (dark SUV) appears involved in the immediate aftermath; multiple cars are stopped or disabled across lanes.

A silver SUV (appears to be a Toyota Land Cruiser Prado) pulls out from the left side of the road and collides with the front-left side of the dashcam vehicle. The impact is visible as the SUV's front bumper makes contact and the dashcam vehicle's hood is pushed upward.
